q1.question: How do I create an account?
q1.answer: To create an account, click on the "Sign Up" button in the top right corner of the page. Fill in your details including your name, email address, and password. Once submitted, you'll receive a verification email. Click the link in the email to verify your account and start shopping.

q2.question: I forgot my password. How do I reset it?
q2.answer: If you've forgotten your password, click on the "Login" button, then select "Forgot Password". Enter the email address associated with your account, and we'll send you a password reset link. Follow the instructions in the email to create a new password.

q3.question: How can I update my account information?
q3.answer: To update your account information, log in to your account and go to the "My Account" section. From there, select "Profile" or "Account Settings" where you can edit your personal information, change your password, and update your preferences.

q4.question: What payment methods do you accept?
q4.answer: We accept various payment methods including credit/debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express), PayPal, Apple Pay, and Google Pay. All transactions are secure and encrypted to protect your information.

q5.question: Is it safe to use my credit card on your website?
q5.answer: Yes, our website uses industry-standard SSL encryption to protect your personal and payment information. We are PCI DSS compliant and never store your full credit card details on our servers.

q6.question: When will my payment be processed?
q6.answer: Your payment will be processed immediately after you place your order. If there are any issues with your payment, you will be notified via email with instructions on how to resolve the issue.

q7.question: How long will it take to receive my order?
q7.answer: Standard shipping typically takes 3-5 business days within the continental US. Express shipping is available for 1-2 business day delivery. International shipping times vary by location, usually between 7-14 business days.

q8.question: Do you ship internationally?
q8.answer: Yes, we ship to most countries worldwide. International shipping rates and delivery times vary by location. You can see the shipping options available to your country during checkout.

q9.question: How can I track my order?
q9.answer: Once your order ships, you will receive a shipping confirmation email with a tracking number. You can use this number to track your package on our website under "Order Tracking" or directly through the carrier's website.

q10.question: What is your return policy?
q10.answer: We offer a 30-day return policy for most items. Products must be returned in their original condition and packaging. Please visit our Returns page for more details and to initiate a return.

q11.question: How do I return an item?
q11.answer: To return an item, log in to your account, go to "Order History", and select the order containing the item you wish to return. Click "Return Items" and follow the instructions. You'll receive a return shipping label via email.

q12.question: When will I receive my refund?
q12.answer: Once we receive and inspect your return, we'll process your refund. This typically takes 3-5 business days. The refund will be issued to your original payment method and may take an additional 2-7 business days to appear on your statement, depending on your bank or credit card company.

q13.question: Do you offer price matching?
q13.answer: Yes, we offer price matching for identical products found at a lower price from an authorized retailer. Please contact our customer service team with details of the competitor's offer within 14 days of your purchase.

q14.question: Are your products covered by warranty?
q14.answer: Most products come with a manufacturer's warranty. The warranty period and coverage vary by product and brand. Warranty information is listed on the product page and included with your purchase.

q15.question: How can I contact customer service?
q15.answer: You can contact our customer service team through various channels: email at support@techstore.vn, phone at 1900 1234 during business hours (Mon-Fri, 9AM-6PM EST), or through the live chat feature on our website.

shipping.freeDesc: On all orders over $50 within the continental US
shipping.fastDesc: Most orders delivered within 3-5 business days
shipping.processingP1: Orders are typically processed within 1-2 business days after payment confirmation. During peak seasons or promotional periods, processing may take an additional 1-2 business days.
shipping.processingP2: Once your order ships, you will receive a shipping confirmation email with tracking information. You can also track your order by logging into your account and viewing your order history.
shipping.intlInfoP1: We ship to most countries worldwide. International customers may be subject to import duties, taxes, and customs clearance fees, which are the responsibility of the recipient. These charges vary by country and are not included in the shipping cost or product price.
shipping.intlInfoP2: International delivery times may vary depending on customs processing in your country. Please allow additional time for international shipments to arrive.
shipping.returnPolicyP1: We offer a 30-day return policy for most items. To be eligible for a return, your item must be unused, in the same condition that you received it, and in its original packaging. Certain products, such as personalized items or downloadable software, are not eligible for return.
shipping.returnPolicyP2: To initiate a return, please log into your account, go to your order history, and select the order containing the item you wish to return. Follow the instructions to generate a return shipping label and return authorization.
shipping.refundP1: Once we receive and inspect your return, we'll send you an email to notify you that we have received your returned item. We will also notify you of the approval or rejection of your refund.
shipping.refundP2: If approved, your refund will be processed, and a credit will automatically be applied to your original method of payment within 3-5 business days. Please note that it may take an additional 2-7 business days for the refund to appear on your statement, depending on your financial institution.
shipping.refundP3: Shipping costs are non-refundable. If you receive a refund, the cost of return shipping will be deducted from your refund unless the return is due to our error (you received an incorrect or defective item).
shipping.exchangeP: If you need to exchange an item for the same product in a different size or color, please initiate a return and place a new order for the desired item. This ensures the fastest processing time and availability of your preferred item.
shipping.damagedP: If you receive a damaged or defective item, please contact our customer service team within 48 hours of receiving your order. We will provide instructions for returning the item and send a replacement or issue a full refund, including shipping costs.

faq1.question: Can I change my shipping address after placing an order?
faq1.answer: If you need to change your shipping address, please contact our customer service team as soon as possible. We can usually accommodate address changes if the order has not yet been processed for shipping.

faq2.question: Do you ship to PO boxes?
faq2.answer: Yes, we ship to PO boxes for standard shipping. However, express shipping and some larger items may require a physical address for delivery.

faq3.question: How can I track my order?
faq3.answer: Once your order ships, you will receive a shipping confirmation email with tracking information. You can also track your order by logging into your account and viewing your order history.

faq4.question: What should I do if my package is lost or stolen?
faq4.answer: If your tracking information shows that your package was delivered but you haven't received it, please check with neighbors or your local post office first. If you believe your package is lost or stolen, contact our customer service team within 7 days of the delivery date, and we'll help resolve the issue.

faq5.question: Can I return a gift?
faq5.answer: Yes, gifts can be returned following our standard return policy. You'll need the order number or gift receipt. The refund will be issued as a store credit to the gift recipient.

contact.title: Need More Help?
contact.desc: If you have any questions about shipping, returns, or refunds, our customer service team is here to help.

privacy.intro: At TechStore, we take your privacy seriously. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website or make a purchase. Please read this privacy policy carefully. If you do not agree with the terms of this privacy policy, please do not access the site.

s1.title: Information We Collect
s1.intro: We collect information about you in various ways when you use our website. This information may include:
s1.personalBody: Name, email address, postal address, phone number, and other information you provide when creating an account, making a purchase, or contacting customer service.
s1.transBody: Details about purchases you make, including payment information, product details, and shipping information.
s1.logBody: Information that your browser automatically sends whenever you visit our website, including your IP address, browser type, operating system, and referring URLs.
s1.cookieBody: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to track activity on our website and hold certain information to enhance your experience.

s2.title: How We Use Your Information
s2.intro: We may use the information we collect for various purposes, including to:
s2.u2: Provide customer service and respond to inquiries
s2.u3: Send transactional emails and order confirmations
s2.u5: Improve our website and product offerings

s3.title: Sharing Your Information
s3.intro: We may share your information with third parties in the following situations:
s3.providerBody: We may share your information with third-party service providers who perform services on our behalf, such as payment processing, shipping, data analysis, email delivery, and customer service.
s3.bizBody: If we are involved in a merger, acquisition, or sale of all or a portion of our assets, your information may be transferred as part of that transaction.
s3.legalBody: We may disclose your information if required to do so by law or in response to valid requests by public authorities.
s3.consentBody: We may share your information with third parties when you have given us your consent to do so.

s4.title: Data Security
s4.body: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to maintain the safety of your personal information. However, no Internet transmission is ever completely secure or error-free. In particular, emails sent to or from our website may not be secure, and you should take special care in deciding what information you send to us via email.

s5.title: Your Rights
s5.intro: Depending on your location, you may have certain rights regarding your personal information, including:
s5.r1: The right to access personal information we hold about you
s5.r2: The right to request correction of inaccurate information
s5.r3: The right to request deletion of your information
s5.r4: The right to object to processing of your information
s5.outro: To exercise these rights, please contact us using the information provided in the "Contact Us" section below.

s6.title: Cookies
s6.body: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to track activity on our website and hold certain information. Cookies are files with a small amount of data which may include an anonymous unique identifier. You can instruct your browser to refuse all cookies or to indicate when a cookie is being sent. However, if you do not accept cookies, you may not be able to use some portions of our website.

s7.title: Children's Privacy
s7.body: Our website is not intended for children under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you are a parent or guardian and you are aware that your child has provided us with personal information, please contact us so that we can take necessary actions.
